summary: Covenant Logistics Group filed a Form 8-K to disclose routine compensation actions approved by its Compensation Committee on May 13, 2026, including 2026 Long-Term Incentive Plan awards (target amounts from $481,000 to $2,984,000) with performance- and time-based vesting, new annualized base salaries for certain named executive officers ($400,000 to $455,000), and amendments to severance agreements providing salary continuation and prorated bonus. No special situation such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring is present; the filing represents ordinary executive compensation disclosure.
